## Problem
Describe the user/data/compliance problem and link the issue.

## Scope
List the affected API, bot, database, access-control, reporting, migration, or documentation paths.

## Validation
- [ ] targeted regression tests passed
- [ ] full pytest suite passed or the limitation is documented
- [ ] migrations were reviewed when schema changed

## Security and data protection
- [ ] tenant/company/site isolation is preserved
- [ ] no production personal data or secrets are included
- [ ] auth/access-control changes have focused regression coverage

## Compliance impact
Describe any ArbZG, retention, correction, audit, or export behavior affected. State explicitly when there is no compliance impact.

## AI assistance
If AI tools materially assisted implementation/tests/review, note the workflow and what the maintainer independently verified.

## Remaining risks
List known limitations or reasons this PR should remain draft.
